definitions.explanation: A facility where convicted criminals serve their sentences. The formal term used in legal and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{刑務所|けいむしょ}に{入|はい}った。
{刑務所|けいむしょ}から{出|で}たばかりの{男|おとこ}がいる。
examples.english: There's a man who just got out of prison.

examples.japanese: その{犯人|はんにん}は{刑務所|けいむしょ}で{十年間|じゅうねんかん}{過|す}ごすことになった。
examples.english: The criminal ended up spending ten years in prison.

notes: The standard word for a prison facility. Often abbreviated in casual speech. Common collocations include {刑務所|けいむしょ}に{入|はい}る (to go to prison), {刑務所|けいむしょ}から{出|で}る (to get out of prison), and {刑務所|けいむしょ}に{収容|しゅうよう}される (to be incarcerated). Compare with {拘置所|こうちしょ} (detention center, for those awaiting trial) and {留置場|りゅうちじょう} (police holding cell).
